summary: Verified browser tab title change. At first the site still showed 'Emergent | Fullstack App' and the old meta description 'A product of emergent.sh'. Cause: craco.config.js watchOptions ignores '**/public/**', so the dev server kept serving the old index.html even though the file had been edited. After `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`, document.title is exactly 'creatorlive247.com' on /, /sign-in, /dashboard (after Clerk ticket sign-in), /setup, /library, /plans and after in-app navigation. Meta description is now 'CreatorLive24/7 - Live stream to YouTube & Facebook. Tripoliya, Patna, Bihar.' Landing page renders with no regression.
action_items: Remember: edits to /app/frontend/public/* need `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`, because craco ignores public/** in watch mode (already restarted this time)
critical_code_review_comments: index.html still loads https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js. It is a platform script, so leave it unless the user asks; it does not change the title.
updated_files: /app/tests/get_ticket.py (helper to mint a Clerk sign-in ticket)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sign in to the UI with: python /app/tests/get_ticket.py, then open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<token>. Edits under public/ need a frontend restart.
rca of the issue: Stale title came from the craco dev-server watch setting that ignores public/**, so HtmlWebpackPlugin kept the cached template. Fixed by restarting the frontend; no code change needed.
